title: Gemini now lets you turn off the visible watermark on your AI creations — here's how to do it, and how your content is still flagged as AI
summary: As announced by Google's Josh Woodward , you can now toggle watermarks off for images made with the Nano Banana AI model, videos made with Omni, and songs made with Lyria — except in countries where visible watermarks are required by law…
